_arch_note: NARROWED vanilla dense-GELU baseline (task 61838fe7). Standard MinimalGPT/MinimalBlock, plain 2-layer GELU MLP FFN, but WITHOUT the usual 4x widening: dense_inner_dim=384 (=d_model) instead of 4*d_model=1536. No LUT, no hybrid. Everything else identical to the standard vanilla baseline (exp_n_0177/0216 recipe) on the proper 16k schedule (same as exp_n_0135/0176): n_steps=16000, linear warmup 1600 (0.1 frac), cosine decay to 0.1x floor, peak LR 3.0e-4, wd 0.1, d_model=384, 6L 6heads seq512, untied, bs48/ga1 eff 24576, seed 1, corrected fixed eval bs48x100 skip12. Purpose: an iso-d_model (1x, not 4x) dense FFN baseline to sit alongside the 16k hybrids (0217 1.140920 / 0218 1.147392) and the full-width 16k vanilla (0135 seed1 1.165147 / 0176 seed2 1.161798) -- shows what a parameter-lean dense FFN (inner=384) achieves vs the full 4x FFN and vs the LUT arms. FFN params/layer = 2*384*384 = 294,912 (vs 4x = 1,179,648). TRITON_CACHE_DIR set in wrapper.
